nodes.label: Connected Transactions
nodes.summary: Rules governing transactions between a listed issuer and connected persons under MBL Chapter 14A, including definition, de minimis exemptions, and procedural requirements.

nodes.label: Definition of Connected Person
nodes.summary: A connected person includes a director, chief executive, or substantial shareholder of the issuer (or any of its subsidiaries) and their associates, as defined in MBL Rule 14A.07.

nodes.label: MBL Rule 14A.07 — Meaning of Connected Person
nodes.summary: Defines connected persons to include directors, chief executives, substantial shareholders, and their associates.

nodes.label: MBL Rule 14A.11 — Associates of Connected Persons
nodes.summary: Defines associates, including family interests, controlled companies, and trustees.

nodes.label: De Minimis Exemptions
nodes.summary: Transactions below the de minimis thresholds (0.1% ratio, or 1% on an aggregated basis) are fully exempt. Transactions below 5% ratio are exempt from independent shareholder approval but require annual reporting.

nodes.label: MBL Rule 14A.76 — De Minimis Exemption
nodes.summary: Transactions where all percentage ratios are below 0.1% are fully exempt; below 1% on an aggregated basis are also exempt.

nodes.label: MBL Rule 14A.77 — Reporting Exemption
nodes.summary: Transactions below 5% ratio are exempt from independent shareholder approval but must be reported in the annual report.

nodes.label: Procedural Requirements — Announcement, Circular, Independent Approval
nodes.summary: Connected transactions above the de minimis threshold require: (a) an announcement; (b) a circular with independent board committee recommendation; (c) independent shareholder approval (with connected persons abstaining); and (d) a fairness opinion or valuation.

nodes.label: MBL Rule 14A.35 — Announcement Requirement
nodes.summary: A connected transaction must be announced as soon as possible after the terms are agreed.

nodes.label: MBL Rule 14A.40 — Independent Shareholder Approval
nodes.summary: Connected transactions require approval by independent shareholders at a general meeting; the connected person and its associates must abstain.

nodes.label: MBL Rule 14A.68 — Independent Board Committee
nodes.summary: An independent board committee comprising independent non-executive directors must be formed to advise shareholders on the connected transaction.

nodes.label: Continuing Connected Transactions
nodes.summary: Recurring transactions in the ordinary course of business (e.g. lease payments, management fees) may be covered by an annual cap approved by independent shareholders, with quarterly reporting on cap utilisation.

nodes.label: MBL Rule 14A.52 — Annual Cap for Continuing CCTs
nodes.summary: Continuing connected transactions must have an annual cap; if the cap is exceeded, the issuer must re-comply with chapter requirements.

nodes.label: MBL Rule 14A.53 — Quarterly Reporting of CCT Cap
nodes.summary: Issuers must report quarterly on the utilisation of the annual cap for continuing connected transactions.

nodes.label: Identify Connected Person Involvement
nodes.summary: Step 1: Determine if the counterparty or beneficiary is a connected person.

nodes.label: Calculate De Minimis Thresholds
nodes.summary: Step 2: Calculate percentage ratios; if all below 0.1%, fully exempt; if below 5%, announcement + reporting only.

nodes.label: Obtain Independent Approvals
nodes.summary: Step 3: Form independent board committee, obtain independent valuation or fairness opinion, convene shareholder meeting.

nodes.label: Announce and Dispatch Circular
nodes.summary: Step 4: Publish announcement, dispatch circular, obtain independent shareholder approval at general meeting.

nodes.label: Identify Counterparty as Connected Person
nodes.summary: Step 1: Determine whether the counterparty is a connected person under LR 14A.07.

nodes.label: Determine Transaction Value and Size Tests
nodes.summary: Step 2: Calculate transaction value and all percentage ratios for classification.

nodes.label: Check Fully Exempt
nodes.summary: Step 3: Check if transaction is fully exempt (all ratios <0.1% or <5% with consideration <HK$1M).

nodes.label: Check Partially Exempt
nodes.summary: Step 4: Check if transaction is partially exempt (announcement required but no shareholder approval).

nodes.label: If Non-Exempt: Appoint IFA
nodes.summary: Step 5: For non-exempt transactions, appoint independent financial adviser.

nodes.label: Issue Announcement
nodes.summary: Step 6: Publish connected transaction announcement via HKEX.

nodes.label: Despatch Circular
nodes.summary: Step 7: Dispatch circular to shareholders with independent board committee recommendation.

nodes.label: Convene Independent Shareholder Vote
nodes.summary: Step 8: Convene general meeting; connected persons must abstain from voting.
